scope: Official manufacturer, service, operator or public-authority references. Roles are editorial learning associations, not a course procurement list. No copied article bodies, logos or photographs. Existing source IDs are retained only when the linked page is already in sources.json; newly found pages are recorded here without inventing global source IDs.
